field.placeholder: Leave blank to include all months

group.p: Upload .xlsx with one entry per row and columns: Employee, Charge Date, Amount, Category (hospital/damage/penalty/meals/other), Description, Repayment From, Installment Count, Anzer Reference (optional). Dates may be Excel dates or YYYY-MM-DD. Imports create linked draft invoices using the configured Staff Credit debit and Original Invoice credit accounts. Review and post each invoice through Accounting.

form.p: Creates one month-end draft per staff member, using only the selected staff credit bills. Missing selected bills are added to an existing draft; posted batches open only when all selected bills are already included. To change an unused batch, delete its draft and generate it again. Posting is a separate Accounting action.

When bills are selected, only those bills are exported. From a bill form, only that bill is exported. For a company-wide report, open Export Excel from the list without selecting rows. Optional filters narrow the result. Settlement, balance and completed repayments are calculated through month-end when a month is selected, or through today when Month is blank. Times shows completed / total repayments, covering the oldest installments first. Drafts do not count; the monthly amount remains planned.
